mapper.select: SELECT order_id FROM wms_outbound_package WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND package_id = #{packageId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.quantity), 0) FROM wms_sales_package_pick pp JOIN wms_outbound_package p ON p.tenant_id = pp.tenant_id AND p.package_id = pp.package_id WHERE pp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pp.pick_id = #{pickId} AND p.status != 'CANCELLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_sales_package_pick(tenant_id, package_id, pick_id, quantity) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{packageId}, #{pickId}, #{quantity})
mapper.sql: FROM wms_sales_package_pick pp JOIN wms_actual_pick k ON k.tenant_id = pp.tenant_id AND k.request_id = pp.pick_id JOIN wms_outbound_allocation a ON a.tenant_id = k.tenant_id AND a.allocation_id = k.allocation_id JOIN wms_warehouse_location p ON p.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND p.location_id = a.location_id JOIN wms_inbound_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND l.batch_no = a.batch_no JOIN wms_inbound_order o ON o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.order_id = l.order_id
mapper.select:
SELECT pp.pick_id, a.allocation_id, a.line_id, a.sales_line_id, a.seller_sku, a.location_id, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode) AS location_code, a.batch_no, o.order_id, o.reference_id, pp.quantity
WHERE pp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pp.package_id = #{packageId} ORDER BY a.seller_sku, a.batch_no, a.location_id, pp.pick_id
SELECT quantity - picked_quantity FROM wms_batch_location_balance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND batch_no = #{line.batchNo} AND location_id = #{line.locationId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.quantity), 0) FROM wms_sales_package_pick pp JOIN wms_outbound_package p ON p.tenant_id = pp.tenant_id AND p.package_id = pp.package_id WHERE pp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.order_id = #{outboundId} AND p.status = 'SHIPPED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_sales_shipment(tenant_id, package_id, outbound_id, operator_id, shipped_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{packageId}, #{outboundId}, #{operatorId}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT operator_id, oms_sync_status, sync_error FROM wms_sales_shipment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND package_id = #{packageId}
SELECT oms_sync_status FROM wms_sales_shipment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND package_id = #{packageId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_sales_shipment SET sync_error = '订单回写失败，可重试', sync_attempts = sync_attempts + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND package_id = #{packageId} AND oms_sync_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, package_id FROM wms_sales_shipment WHERE oms_sync_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY sync_attempts, shipped_at, tenant_id, package_id LIMIT 100

SELECT p.package_id FROM wms_outbound_package p JOIN wms_sales_pick_work w ON w.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND w.outbound_id = p.order_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} ORDER BY p.created_at, p.package_id
